description: The page asks for a one-time / verification / 2FA code after the password: call this. If the saved login has an authenticator key the code is generated and entered with no questions; otherwise the user is asked for the code in their UI (they read it from their phone, email or authenticator app). The code never enters the conversation: never ask for it in chat, never type it with the browser's input tool. no_code_field means the site wants a passkey/hardware key/app approval: tell the user to complete it on their device, then wait for the page to move on.
name: browser_vault_enter_code

handle.description: The login handle you just filled (lets Hermes generate the code when an authenticator key is saved).
